messages:
jess: Quick sync — onboarding orion-34b (34B, MQA) to staging. I pushed weights to s3://redwood-models/orion/34b/v1/ — can someone sanity-check tokenizer/rope and sliding-window configs before I kick canary? Thanks
ryan: I can take tokenizer. quick grep showed tokenizer.json has bos_token set to `<s>` (id 1) and adds a custom unk mapping. might need remap for our kv cache indexing. do you have the vocab + merges? :thinking: 
jess: vocab + merges are in the same s3 dir. tokenizer seems to be byte-level bpe variant, but there's a reported "pad" id collision when sequence len > 2048 in local tests.
akash: Re RoPE: model was exported with rope_scale = 1.0 but our runtime uses scaled_rope multipliers for LlamaX family. we should set runtime param `rope_scaling: { type: "linear", factor: 1.0 }` for now. otherwise attention scores explode at ~3k tokens. quick snippet:

```yaml
runtime:
  rope_scaling: { type: linear, factor: 1.0 }
  kv_cache_policy: paging
  gqa_mode: mqa
  sliding_window: { stride: 512, chunk: 2048 }
```

akash: also ensure `gqa_mode` matches weights (gqa vs mqa), mismatches cause shape errors at load.
maya: I ran a small serve smoke: canary failed with `matmul` size mismatch in q_proj when gqa_mode mismatch. re-uploaded a compat config to the s3 dir: s3://redwood-models/orion/34b/v1/compat/compat-v1.json
deploy-bot: CI: artifact-scan passed, checksum ok. canary pipeline started by @jess. logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/pipelines/2345
olivia: For rollout: recommend canary at 1%, 1 hour, monitor token latency and kv cache hit rate. If kv hit < 60% we abort. :warning: 
jess: thanks all. akash / ryan — can you pair tomorrow 9am PT to lock rope/gqa params? maya, can you add a short eval set that hits 4k token sequences? I'll update the onboarding checklist after this.
ryan: ack, will bring tokenizer testcases.
akash: ack, will validate rope scaling and try automatic detection patch.
maya: will add eval set, dropping samples to s3 in `tests/onboard/orion-34b/`.
jess: resolving after pairing + successful canary. :white_check_mark:
